advancement.fealty.bandit_followers.desc: Hire a bandit to fight for you.
advancement.fealty.courier.desc: Deliver a sealed letter to another village's elder.
advancement.fealty.defender.desc: Help a village win a raid.
advancement.fealty.guild_member.desc: Take a job from the thieves guild.
advancement.fealty.met_elder.desc: Speak with a village's trusting elder.
advancement.fealty.redemption.desc: Climb back out of disgrace through the elder's quests.
advancement.fealty.restored: The Elder Is Dead, Long Live the Elder
advancement.fealty.restored.desc: Raise a new elder for a Broken village.
advancement.fealty.root.desc: Every village remembers how you treat it.
advancement.fealty.royal_writ.desc: Join the Signet and the Charter into a Royal Writ.
advancement.fealty.rumours.desc: Ask a village elder about the old rumours.
advancement.fealty.sworn_lord.desc: Have a village swear fealty to you.
advancement.fealty.threatened.desc: Threaten a villager into a fair price.
advancement.fealty.tribute.desc: Collect tribute from a village you rule.
advancement.fealty.unseen_theft.desc: Steal from a village without being seen.
advancement.fealty.usurper.desc: Take a village from another lord.
advancement.fealty.village_broken.desc: Leave a village without its elder.
advancement.fealty.wanted.desc: Have a price put on your head.
fealty.bandit.deserted: %s wants no part of an outlaw gone soft, and leaves you.
fealty.bandit.hired: %s takes your emeralds and falls in behind you.
fealty.bandit.not_infamous: "You? Work for you? Come back when the villages fear your name."
fealty.bandit.too_many: You can't feed any more mouths.
fealty.black_market.refused: "Never seen you before. Honest folk buy honest goods. Go."
fealty.bounty.dispatched: Bounty hunters from %s are on your trail!
fealty.bounty.slain: The bounty hunter falls. Someone will send another.
fealty.chain.charter: The Keeper gives you a charter. Bring it, and the Signet, back to them.
fealty.chain.hint.combine: Bring the Signet and the Charter to the Keeper.
fealty.chain.hint.hamlet: Follow the map to the hidden hamlet near %s, %s.
fealty.chain.hint.steps: Help the named villagers (%s of %s done).
fealty.chain.map_given: With the last piece, you are given the Signet and a map to a hidden hamlet. The Keeper lives there.
fealty.chain.no_hamlet: Nobody knows where the hamlet lies any more. (No hidden hamlet could be found.)
fealty.chain.rumours_locked: Only those the village holds %s hear the old rumours.
fealty.chain.rumours_told: The elder lowers their voice: "There are old stories of a crown, and someone who still keeps its secret. Speak with %s. They know more."
fealty.chain.step_done: One more piece of the story falls into place. %s left.
fealty.chain.subtitle: Of %s
fealty.chain.villager.done: "I've told you all I know. Go on, finish it."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.cartographer: "The old roads? I might be able to help, if you help me."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.cleric: "The Keeper? Hush. Not here. First, there is something I need done."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.smith: "So the elder sent you. Yes, I remember the old seal..."
fealty.chain.villager.idle: "Hm? I don't know what you mean."
fealty.command.restore_pending: %s will have a new elder the next time it is loaded.
fealty.command.village_info: %s [%s] centre %s, structure %s, elder %s, lord %s, tax level %s
fealty.dialogue.broken.0: Our elder is dead. Who will speak for us now?
fealty.dialogue.broken.1: Nothing is the same since the elder fell.
fealty.dialogue.broken.2: They say a neighbouring elder could name a new one...
fealty.dialogue.broken.3: We are lost without our elder.
fealty.dialogue.hated.1: Murderer. Thief. Whatever you are, leave.
fealty.dialogue.hated.2: The guards will hear of this.
fealty.dialogue.hated.3: We have nothing for you here.
fealty.dialogue.honored.0: %s! The whole village is glad you're here.
fealty.dialogue.honored.1: Take this, please. For all you've done.
fealty.dialogue.honored.2: My children tell stories about you.
fealty.dialogue.lord.2: The harvest is good this year, my lord.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.0: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.1: Come by the hall later, there's bread.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.2: The elder speaks well of you.
fealty.elder.greet.distrusted: "You are not welcome, %s, but you are not beyond redemption. Help %s and we may yet think better of you."
fealty.elder.greet.hated: "So you dare come here, %s. If you would mend what you have broken, there are tasks only the desperate would take."
fealty.elder.greet.honored: "%s! %s owes you more than it can repay. Sit, tell me your news."
fealty.elder.greet.neutral: "Welcome to %2$s, traveller. We could use a willing pair of hands."
fealty.elder.greet.trusted: "Ah, %s, a friend of %s. What can I do for you?"
fealty.elder.lost: The elder looks at you blankly. They seem to have forgotten their own village.
fealty.elder.subtitle: Elder of %s
fealty.fence.completed: "You're a guild thief now. Wear it well."
fealty.fence.done: "You're one of us now. Nothing more to teach you."
fealty.fence.recruit: "Word gets around, %s. The guild could use someone like you. Interested?"
fealty.fence.refused: "I don't know what you're talking about. Move along."
fealty.fence.step_done: "Not bad. Here, you've earned this. Come back for the next job."
fealty.fence.subtitle: The Thieves Guild
fealty.gift.cooldown: %s has already accepted a gift from you today.
fealty.gift.not_enough: %s takes the gift, but it will take more than gifts to mend what you did.
fealty.gift.received: %s presses a gift into your hands.
fealty.guard.escort_refused: %s does not take orders from you.
fealty.guard.escort_start: %s will escort you for a while.
fealty.guard.warning: %s: "Halt! Do that again and we will cut you down."
fealty.guard.watching.0: %s: "Keep your hands where I can see them."
fealty.guard.watching.2: %s: "Mind yourself. We remember what you did."
fealty.horn.ordered.defend: %s guards return to defending the village.
fealty.keeper.combine: "You have done all I asked. Give me the Signet and the Charter."
fealty.keeper.combine_action: Join the Signet and the Charter
fealty.keeper.combine_missing: You need the Signet of the Old Crown and the Keeper's Charter.
fealty.keeper.done: "Go now. A village awaits its lord."
fealty.keeper.fallen: "Your name has fallen in %s. I do not deal with those their own people distrust. Mend it with the elder there, then return."
fealty.keeper.forged: The Keeper binds signet and charter into a Royal Writ. "Present it to the elder of a village that honours you. They will swear fealty."
fealty.keeper.stranger: "I don't know you, stranger. There is nothing here for you. Go."
fealty.keeper.subtitle: Keeper of the Old Crown
fealty.keeper.trial_offer: "So %s still trusts you. Good. Prove yourself to me as well."
fealty.ledger.empty: You have not yet made a name with any village. Visit one and its people will remember you.
fealty.ledger.title: Fealty Ledger
fealty.lord.lost: The people of %s have renounced their fealty to you.
fealty.lord.new_horn: Ask for a new Lord's Horn
fealty.lord.problem.broken: A Broken village cannot swear fealty.
fealty.lord.problem.loved_lord: %s rules here, and the people love them more than you.
fealty.lord.problem.not_honored: Only a village that holds you %s will swear fealty to you.
fealty.lord.problem.too_many: You already rule as many villages as you can hold (%s).
fealty.lord.sworn: The people of %s swear fealty to %s!
fealty.lord.sworn_self: You are now the lord of %s. Its tribute will gather in the village coffer, and its guards answer your horn.
fealty.lord.tribute: Tribute from %s has been paid into the village coffer (%s measures).
fealty.pickpocket.empty: %s has nothing left worth taking today.
fealty.quest.already_active: You are already on a quest for them. Finish or abandon it first.
fealty.quest.clear_camp.line: Defeat the captain of the bandit camp near %s, %s
fealty.quest.clear_camp.none: There are no bandit camps anywhere near.
fealty.quest.courier.delivered: You hand over the letter from %s. The elder of %s breaks the seal and nods.
fealty.quest.courier.line: Deliver the sealed letter to the elder of %s (near %s, %s)
fealty.quest.courier.none: There is nowhere to send a letter to.
fealty.quest.courier.preview: Carry a sealed letter to another village's elder
fealty.quest.defend_raid.fighting: The raid is upon the village. Drive them off!
fealty.quest.defend_raid.gathering: A raid is gathering. Stay in the village and be ready.
fealty.quest.defend_raid.no_raid: No raiders will come here now (peaceful difficulty, or raids are disabled).
fealty.quest.defend_raid.preview: Hold the village through a raid
fealty.quest.failed.giver_lost: Quest failed, the quest giver is gone: %s
fealty.quest.not_ready: You do not have what the quest needs yet.
fealty.quest.pickpocket.line: Pick %s pockets unseen (%s/%s). Sneak up behind a villager with an empty hand.
fealty.quest.ready: %s is done. Return to hand it in.
fealty.quest.rebuild.line: Clear the rubble near %s, %s, %s and put the right blocks back (%s/%s)
fealty.quest.rebuild.nothing: Nothing here needs rebuilding right now.
fealty.quest.rebuild.preview: Rebuild %s damaged blocks of a building
fealty.quest.rebuild.unloaded: Come back when you can see the village properly.
fealty.quest.rebuild.wrong: That doesn't belong there. It was %s.
fealty.quest.restore.none: No village nearby needs an elder.
fealty.quest.restore.preview: Restore the elder of a Broken village
fealty.quest.restore.stage0: Gather the makings of an elder's mantle for %s:
fealty.quest.restore.stage1: Take the Elder's Mantle to %s (near %s, %s) and place it on a villager there (sneak + use).
fealty.quest.steal.bring: Bring the goods to the fence.
fealty.quest.steal.seen: You were seen. The guild wants it done quietly.
fealty.quest.vault_raid.line: Empty %s village coffers without being seen (%s/%s). A lockpick keeps it quiet.
fealty.renown.fall: Your %s falls: you are known as %s across the land.
fealty.renown.rise: Your %s rises: you are known as %s across the land.
fealty.screen.no_quests: There is nothing more to ask of you today.
fealty.threat.cowers: %s cowers: "Fine! Fine, take what you want. Just this once." (Their next trade is at the Neutral price.)
fealty.threat.refuses: %s has had enough of your threats and will not trade with you for a day.
fealty.threat.too_scared: %s is too frightened to deal with you at all.
fealty.trade.refused_hated: %s will not trade with the likes of you. (Hated: only a threat will make them.)
fealty.trade.refused_threats: %s refuses to trade with you today.
fealty.tyrant.appears: The Tyrant Lord rides out of %s to face you!
fealty.tyrant.fallen_other: Someone else has killed the Tyrant Lord.
fealty.tyrant.risen: The Tyrant Lord has seized %s (near %s, %s) and waits there for you.
fealty.tyrant.slain: %s has slain the Tyrant Lord and freed %s!
fealty.village.broken: %s, the elder of %s, is dead. The village is Broken and offers no more quests until an elder is restored.
fealty.wanted.level1: %s has put a price on your head. Bounty hunters are coming.
fealty.wanted.level2: %s has called on the Tyrant Lord to hunt you.
item.fealty.bounty_notice.desc: A price was on someone's head. Not any more.
item.fealty.elders_mantle.desc: Place it on a villager of a Broken village (sneak + use) to raise a new elder.
item.fealty.keepers_charter.desc: The Keeper's charter. Joined with the Signet, it makes a Royal Writ.
item.fealty.ledger.desc: Your standing with every village and band you have met.
item.fealty.lockpick.desc: Hold it while opening a village coffer to open it quietly.
item.fealty.lords_horn.desc: Use in a village you rule to command its guards. Sneak and use to choose the order.
item.fealty.rogue_set.desc: Full set: while sneaking, witnesses only see you from half as far.
item.fealty.royal_writ.desc: Present it to the elder of a village that honours you, and its people will swear fealty to you.
item.fealty.signet_of_the_old_crown.desc: Half of an old royal seal. The Keeper holds the other half's secret.
item.fealty.smoke_bomb.desc: Throw it. Nobody in the smoke can see a crime.
item.fealty.tyrant_crown.desc: While worn, threatening villagers costs no reputation.
quest.fealty.bandit_menace.desc: Bandits rob our carts on the road. Find their camp and put down their captain.
quest.fealty.beast_of_the_fen.desc: Something has been taking our sheep. Hunt it down.
quest.fealty.blood_price.desc: There is only one price for what you did: something that cheats death itself.
quest.fealty.bread_for_the_hall.desc: The hall feeds the village through the lean weeks. Bring bread.
quest.fealty.chain.cartographer_survey.d: "There was a map of the old roads once. Bring me what I need to redraw it."
quest.fealty.chain.cleric_relic.desc: "The last of the old order walks again. Lay him to rest and bring me peace of mind."
quest.fealty.chain.keeper_trial.desc: "An oathbreaker haunts these woods. Defeat him, and I will know you are worthy."
quest.fealty.chain.smith_ore.desc: "The old seal had a key. I can forge another, but I need good metal."
quest.fealty.costly_amends.desc: You have done great harm. Pay for it, in diamonds and gold.
quest.fealty.guild.first_lift.desc: "Every thief starts with pockets. Pick three without anyone seeing."
quest.fealty.guild.light_fingers.desc: "Eight emeralds from village chests. Nobody sees you, or it doesn't count."
quest.fealty.guild.masterwork.desc: "Two coffers, two villages, not a soul the wiser. Then you're one of us."
quest.fealty.guild.the_strongbox.desc: "Every village keeps a coffer by its elder. Empty one, quietly."
quest.fealty.harvest_tithe.desc: The granary is low. Bring wheat and carrots for the winter stores.
quest.fealty.healers_herbs.desc: The healer needs rare things for her remedies.
quest.fealty.hold_the_walls.desc: Raiders are coming. Stand with the village when they do.
quest.fealty.last_stand.desc: A great raid gathers. Only those who hold the line will be forgiven.
quest.fealty.mend_the_walls.desc: Part of a house has crumbled. Clear the rubble and rebuild it.
quest.fealty.night_terror.desc: A horror stalks the village at night. Kill it, if you can.
quest.fealty.ore_for_the_smithy.desc: The smith needs iron and coal to keep the forge burning.
quest.fealty.outlaw_purge.desc: Prove you are not one of them. Destroy a bandit camp's captain.
quest.fealty.ravager_of_the_roads.desc: A brute of an illager waylays travellers. End it.
quest.fealty.rebuild_the_hall.desc: The hall itself lies in ruins. Rebuild it, stone by stone.
quest.fealty.restock_workshops.desc: Our craftsfolk lost their tools. Build new workstations in the village.
quest.fealty.restore_the_elder.desc: A nearby village lost its elder. Help them raise a new one.
quest.fealty.sealed_letter.desc: Carry this letter to the elder of a neighbouring village. Do not break the seal.
quest.fealty.timber_for_repairs.desc: Roofs leak and fences sag. Bring logs for the carpenters.
quest.fealty.urgent_dispatch.desc: This letter cannot wait. Deliver it within two days.
quest.fealty.wool_for_winter.desc: Winter comes early this year. Bring wool for blankets.
fealty.journal.title: Journal
fealty.journal.no_quests_hint: Village elders and villagers give work to those they trust. Talk to them to find quests. Accepted quests appear here and in the tracker.
fealty.journal.no_lordships: You rule no villages yet. Earn a Royal Writ and swear fealty with an elder to become a village's lord.
fealty.command.scan_none: No village here. Add the structure to "extra_village_structures" in the server config, or use /rep village create.
fealty.command.already_village: There is already a village here.
fealty.line.greet.hated.3: We've nothing for the likes of you.
fealty.line.greet.distrusted.0: Hmph. Keep your hands where I can see them.
fealty.line.greet.neutral.3: Mind the crops on your way through.
fealty.line.greet.trusted.2: The village speaks well of you.
fealty.line.greet.honored.2: You honour us with your visit, %s.
fealty.line.greet.broken.0: Since the elder passed, nothing feels right.
fealty.line.greet.broken.1: Without the elder, who will lead us?
fealty.line.greet.broken.2: Have you heard? The elder is gone...
fealty.line.greet.librarian.0: Have you read any good books lately?
fealty.line.greet.cleric.1: I sense a heavy heart in you.
fealty.line.greet.armorer.1: A good helm has saved many a head.
fealty.line.greet.weaponsmith.0: A blade is only as good as its wielder.
fealty.line.greet.toolsmith.0: A good pick never lets you down.
fealty.line.greet.cartographer.0: The world is bigger than you think.
fealty.line.greet.cartographer.1: I've maps to places you've never dreamed of.
fealty.line.greet.shepherd.1: Have you seen a lost sheep?
fealty.line.greet.leatherworker.1: Rabbit hide makes the softest gloves.
fealty.line.greet.nitwit.0: Have you seen my... what was I looking for?
fealty.line.greet.nitwit.1: I counted the clouds today. Seven! Or eight.
fealty.line.greet.none.1: Know anyone who needs a hand?
fealty.line.greet_child.hated.1: Mama! The bad one is here!
fealty.line.greet_child.neutral.1: Mama says not to talk to strangers.
fealty.line.greet_child.trusted.2: When I grow up I want to be like you!
fealty.line.work_none.any.1: Ask the elder; they always need help.
fealty.line.news.any.0: They say bandits camp out past the hills.
fealty.line.news.any.1: The harvest looks good this year.
fealty.line.news.any.3: A trader came by with strange goods.
fealty.line.news.any.4: Someone's been stealing from the farms.
fealty.line.news.any.5: The roads aren't safe after dark.
fealty.line.news.any.6: I heard there's a hidden village, deep in the woods.
fealty.line.news.any.7: The guards have been on edge lately.
fealty.line.crime_vandalism.any.0: What are you doing to our village?
fealty.line.crime.any.2: You won't get away with that!
fealty.line.threat_cower.any.1: Take what you want, just leave me be!
fealty.line.threat_cower.any.2: Alright, alright! A fair price, I promise!
fealty.line.threat_refuse.any.0: I'm not doing anything for you anymore!
fealty.line.refuse_hated.any.0: I won't trade with the likes of you.
fealty.line.refuse_hated.any.1: Your coin is no good here.
fealty.line.refuse_threats.any.0: After what you did? No trades for you.
fealty.line.gift_refused.any.0: Gifts won't undo what you did.
fealty.line.gift_cooldown.any.0: You already gave me something today!
fealty.line.gift_cooldown.any.1: Too kind, but I can't take more today.
fealty.line.gift_give.any.0: Here, take this. For all you've done.
fealty.line.gift_give.any.1: A little something for our hero!
fealty.dialogue.subtitle: %s · %s (%s)
fealty.dialogue.option.deliver: I have a letter for you.
fealty.dialogue.letter_thanks: Thank you for bringing this all this way.
fealty.news.wanderer: I don't belong to any village.
fealty.news.wanted: There's a price on your head, %s. Watch yourself.
fealty.news.broken: Since Elder %s died, we've had no one to lead us.
fealty.news.your_lordship: Your village is well, my lord.
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_bonemeal.desc: The soil's tired this year. Could you bring me some bone meal?
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_seeds.desc: I'm short on seed for the next sowing. Wheat seeds, if you can spare them.
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_pests.desc: Something tramples my crops at night. Zombies, I'd wager. Thin them out for me?
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_pumpkins.desc: We're planning a little feast. Two good pumpkins would make it.
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_ink.desc: My inkwell's dry and the records won't copy themselves. Ink sacs, please?
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_paper.desc: I've run out of paper. Twenty-four sheets would see me through the week.
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_ruins.desc: Travellers speak of ancient stone gates in the wilds. Would you find one and tell me of it?
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_flesh.desc: Rotten flesh makes a fine poultice, believe it or not. Bring me some?
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_glow.desc: The shrine needs light. Glowstone dust, if you can find it.
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_undead.desc: The dead walk too close to our homes. Put a few of them to rest.
quest.fealty.favor.armorer_coal.desc: The forge eats coal like a hungry dog. Sixteen lumps, please.
quest.fealty.favor.armorer_iron.desc: I'm mending the guards' mail. A few iron ingots would help.
quest.fealty.favor.weaponsmith_flint.des: Flint makes a fine whetstone. Could you gather some?
quest.fealty.favor.weaponsmith_iron.desc: A few iron ingots and I can arm the watch properly.
quest.fealty.favor.toolsmith_stone.desc: Handles and heads, that's all a tool is. Sticks and cobblestone, please.
quest.fealty.favor.toolsmith_iron.desc: Everyone wants a new pick. I need iron.
quest.fealty.favor.fisherman_cod.desc: My back's acting up and the cod won't catch themselves.
quest.fealty.favor.fisherman_string.desc: My nets are torn. String, and plenty of it.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_wreck.de: Sailors say there's a wreck along the coast. Find it so I can mark it on my charts.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_portal.d: There's a ruined gate somewhere near. Find it and I'll put it on the map.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_glass.de: I'm grinding new lenses. Glass panes, if you have them.
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_wool.desc: A storm scattered my fleeces. White wool to replace them?
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_dye.desc: The weavers want colour. Any dyes will do.
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_wolves.desc: Wolves have been taking my lambs. Drive them off. Please.
quest.fealty.favor.butcher_coal.desc: The smokehouse needs coal to keep going.
quest.fealty.favor.butcher_beef.desc: Business is good, stock is low. Raw beef, if you're hunting anyway.
quest.fealty.favor.mason_clay.desc: I need clay to fire new bricks.
quest.fealty.favor.mason_stone.desc: The walls won't mend themselves. Thirty-two stone, please.
quest.fealty.favor.fletcher_feathers.des: You can never have too many feathers. Well, I can't.
quest.fealty.favor.fletcher_flint.desc: Flint for arrowheads, and I'll owe you one.
quest.fealty.favor.leatherworker_leather: Saddles and satchels need leather. Eight hides?
Rabbit hide makes the softest gloves. Bring me some?
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_poppy.desc: I lost my lucky flower! It was red. A poppy! Find me a poppy?
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_shiny.desc: I collect shiny things. Gold nuggets are the shiniest. Got any?
fealty.talk.nitwit_hello: Your neighbour wanted me to say hello.
fealty.talk.nitwit_hello.reply: Hello? Oh, that one. Tell them hello back, I suppose.
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_hello.desc: Tell the farmer I said hello! They never listen to me.
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_slime.desc: There's a monster in the well! Or near it. Somewhere. Kill a zombie, just in case?
quest.fealty.favor.drifter_bread.desc: I haven't eaten since yesterday. Could you spare some bread?
fealty.talk.drifter_work: Do you need an extra pair of hands? There's someone looking for work.
fealty.talk.drifter_work.reply: Could do. Send them my way.
quest.fealty.favor.drifter_work.desc: I need work. Would you ask the smith if they need a hand?
fealty.talk.any_message: I've a message for you from a neighbour.
fealty.talk.any_message.reply: Ah, thank you. I'll see to it.
quest.fealty.favor.any_message.desc: Would you carry a message for me? It's just across the village.
quest.fealty.favor.any_firewood.desc: The nights are cold. Sixteen logs would keep my hearth going.
quest.fealty.favor.any_torches.desc: Monsters come out where it's dark. Torches, to light the lanes?
quest.fealty.favor.any_locket.desc: I dropped my grandmother's locket on the road and it's gone. I marked where on this map. Would you look?
quest.fealty.favor.any_apples.desc: I promised a pie and I'm short of apples.
quest.fealty.night_watch.desc: The dead come at night and our guards are few. Stand watch and cut them down near the village.
quest.fealty.wolves_in_the_woods.desc: A pack has taken three sheep this month. Hunt them before they take a child.
quest.fealty.spider_nest.desc: Spiders crawl over the walls at night. Clear them from around the village.
quest.fealty.pillager_scouts.desc: Pillagers have been seen watching the roads. Deal with their scouts before they bring an army.
quest.fealty.lost_shipment.desc: Our cart never came back from market. Find it, and the goods it carried.
quest.fealty.stolen_heirloom.desc: Bandits took the village's old signet ring. Their stash is marked on this map. Bring it home.
quest.fealty.buried_tithe.desc: In the old war, the village hid its tithe in the hills. This map shows where. Recover it.
quest.fealty.survey_the_ruins.desc: There are ruins near here we know nothing about. Go and see them, then tell me what you found.
fealty.talk.errand: The elder would like a word with you.
fealty.talk.errand.reply: Does the elder now? Tell them I'll be along.
quest.fealty.errand_for_the_elder.desc: Run along and tell the armorer I'd like a word. It's a small thing, but small things build trust.
quest.fealty.atonement_hunt.desc: You want to make amends? Then bleed for us. Twenty of the walking dead, near our walls, by night.
quest.fealty.return_what_was_taken.desc: Bandits stole from us, and some say you helped them. Prove otherwise: bring back what they took.
fealty.talk.bread: The village sent me. Everyone hopes you get well soon.
fealty.talk.bread.reply: Bless you. Tell the elder we're grateful.
quest.fealty.kind_words.desc: The farmer's family has been ill. Go and tell them the whole village is thinking of them.
fealty.line.favor_accepted.any.0: Thank you! Come back when it's done.
fealty.line.favor_accepted.any.2: I knew I could count on you, %s.
fealty.line.favor_thanks.any.2: Exactly what I needed. Thank you!
fealty.line.favor_not_yet.any.1: Not yet, I'm afraid. Come back when you have it all.
fealty.objective.vault_raid: Raid coffers in different villages, unseen
fealty.objective.raid_wait: Wait at the village for the raid
fealty.objective.raid_fight: Defend the village from the raid
fealty.objective.restore_mantle: Hand them to the elder for the Mantle
fealty.objective.talk_to.message: I bring a message for you.
fealty.objective.talk_to.reply: Thank you for letting me know.
fealty.quest.explore.none: There is no %s anywhere near here.
fealty.quest.talk_to.none: There is no one here to take the message.
fealty.quest.talk_to.preview: Carry a message to someone in the village
fealty.quest.too_many: You already have %s quests. Finish or abandon one first.
fealty.screen.abandon_hint: Abandoning a quest may cost reputation
fealty.dialogue.option.favor_done: I have what you asked for.
fealty.favor.accepted: Thank you! Come back when it's done.
